questions.questionText: Two runners start together from the same point on a circular track and run in the same direction. One takes 18 minutes per round and the other 27 minutes. After how many minutes will they next be together at the starting point?
questions.explanation: They meet at the start again after LCM(18, 27) = 54 minutes.
questions.shortcut: Meeting at the start = LCM of lap times.

questions.questionText: Three temple bells at Madurai ring at intervals of 24, 32 and 40 seconds. If they ring together at 6:00 am, after how many seconds will they next ring together?
questions.explanation: Next common ring after LCM(24, 32, 40) = 480 seconds.
questions.shortcut: Next simultaneous event = LCM of intervals.

questions.questionText: Three bells toll at intervals of 21, 35 and 42 seconds and all toll together at the start. How many times will they toll together in 30 minutes, counting the one at the start?
questions.explanation: LCM = 210 s. In 1800 s they coincide 8 more times, plus the start: 9.
questions.shortcut: Count = (total time ÷ LCM) + 1 with the start included.

questions.questionText: Three joggers start together from the same point on a circular park track and run in the same direction. They complete a round in 4, 6 and 9 minutes respectively. How many rounds will the slowest jogger have completed when all three are first together at the start again?
questions.explanation: All together after LCM(4, 6, 9) = 36 min. Slowest takes 9 min per round → 36/9 = 4 rounds.
questions.shortcut: Rounds = LCM ÷ own lap time.

questions.questionText: Three signals change after 40, 60 and 90 seconds. They change together at 7:00:00 am. How many times will they change together after 7:00:00 am up to and including 10:00:00 am (do not count the 7:00:00 am instant)?
questions.explanation: LCM = 360 s. Interval of 3 h = 10800 s. Number of coincidences after the start = floor(10800/360) = 30.
questions.shortcut: floor(total / LCM), then add 1 only if the start is counted.

questions.questionText: Two machines at a plant in Coimbatore ring a buzzer every 40 minutes and every 56 minutes respectively. They last rang together at 9:00 am on Monday. After how many hours will they ring together for the third time from then (excluding the 9:00 am ring)?
questions.explanation: LCM(40, 56) = 280 min. Third coincidence after 3 × 280 = 840 min = 14 hours.
questions.shortcut: n-th coincidence after start = n × LCM.

questions.questionText: Three signals change after 20, 30 and 50 seconds. They change together at 7:00:00 am. How many times will they change together after 7:00:00 am up to and including 8:00:00 am (do not count the 7:00:00 am instant)?
questions.explanation: LCM = 300 s. Interval of 1 h = 3600 s. Number of coincidences after the start = floor(3600/300) = 12.
questions.shortcut: floor(total / LCM), then add 1 only if the start is counted.

questions.questionText: Two machines at a plant in Coimbatore ring a buzzer every 45 minutes and every 60 minutes respectively. They last rang together at 9:00 am on Monday. After how many hours will they ring together for the third time from then (excluding the 9:00 am ring)?
questions.explanation: LCM(45, 60) = 180 min. Third coincidence after 3 × 180 = 540 min = 9 hours.
questions.shortcut: n-th coincidence after start = n × LCM.
